emerging_technology: Satellite imaging spectroscopy for methane point-source detection
intended_application: Publish annual methane totals for a regional landfill inventory
business_need: Produce comparable annual estimates for all landfills, including small sources
capabilities_constraints: Facility activity records and inventory model; no field crew or validated satellite coverage correction.
risk_consequence_context: Incomplete annual totals can misallocate mitigation funds.
management_question: Should plume estimates replace facility-based annual estimates?
additional_context:
